jobs.description: About the Role A legal technology company is seeking a Senior Partner to help grow an AI-enabled law practice in Germany. You will bring an established client practice, continue advising clients, and help move recurring legal work onto AI-powered workflows. What You'll Do Help shape the firm's growth and contribute to its path toward Series A. Transition your portable client practice to the firm's platform while continuing to serve those clients. Build market credibility and develop opportunities through your private equity, venture capital, and mid-market network. Identify cross-selling opportunities for commercial and compliance services across your client base. Work with the founding team to automate recurring legal matters using AI agents. What We're Looking For 12 to 20 or more years of German legal practice, with experience at partner level. German-qualified Volljurist admitted as a Rechtsanwalt, with native-level German and professional English. A personally portable book of business valued at €1 million or more, with a diversified client base that follows you independently of a large-firm brand. Strong relationships with private equity or venture capital firms and their portfolio companies, or a comparable mid-market client network. Experience with recurring, automatable work such as commercial contracts, IT and data, corporate and venture capital, or regulatory matters. Practical experience using AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or legal AI products, and a willingness to adapt legal workflows to automation. A feasible client transition plan, including a notice period and no restrictions that prevent moving your practice. Compensation & Benefits Base salary range: €200,000 to €300,000 annually. jobs.description: PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk adalah sebuah badan usaha milik negara Indonesia yang menyediakan berbagai macam jasa keuangan. Bank yang berkantor pusat di Jakarta ini adalah salah satu bank terbesar di Indonesia dalam hal jumlah aset, pinjaman, dan simpanannya. Bank Mandiri didirikan pada 2 Oktober 1998, sebagai bagian dari program restrukturisasi perbankan yang dilaksanakan oleh pemerintah Indonesia. Pada bulan Juli 1999, empat bank pemerintah yaitu Bank Bumi Daya, Bank Dagang Negara, Bank Ekspor Impor Indonesia dan Bank Pembangunan Indonesia dilebur menjadi Bank Mandiri, dimana masing-masing bank tersebut memiliki peran yang tak terpisahkan dalam pembangunan perekonomian Indonesia. Sampai dengan hari ini, Bank Mandiri meneruskan tradisi selama lebih dari 140 tahun memberikan kontribusi dalam dunia perbankan dan perekonomian Indonesia.
